text: Because a public blockchain is genuinely public and immutable, it increases transparency while simultaneously and significantly reducing transaction costs.
citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, Legal Education in the Blockchain Revolution (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2939127

isBasedOn.name: Legal Education in the Blockchain Revolution

abstract: Because the blockchain (at the least the public blockchain) is in fact public and immutable, the technology increases transparency, while at the same time significantly reducing transaction costs.

value: public blockchains rather than consortium or fully private blockchains
